_doc: Per-term mappings to relevant Operator Sheets. scripts/inject-glossary-sheet-sidecar.mjs reads this and stamps a 'Use this sheet' callout into the matching glossary term page (EN + ES) right after the . Each entry is { term-slug: [sheet-slug, ...] } in priority order — first sheet listed becomes the primary CTA. Built from data/sheets.json's pairsWith.glossary, reverse-indexed (term → sheets that pair with it). When a sheet's pairsWith.glossary list changes, regenerate this file or hand-edit. The injector silently skips sheets whose status !== 'live' so a queued sheet does not surface a 404.
